items.evidence_quote: He was only a shepherd, but he was not afraid.
items.note: 羊飼いのメロスが恐れずに支配者を非難しています。

items.evidence_quote: “You kill people without asking if they did anything wrong!” he shouted.
items.note: 疑いを確かめず人を殺す支配者として描かれています。

items.evidence_quote: A stranger from the crowd stepped forward. “Keep me here. I do not know him
items.note: 友人ではなく、メロスを知らない見知らぬ人が人質になります。

items.evidence_quote: “My guards will kill you too,” said the ruler.
items.note: 非難したメロスに支配者が死を告げています。

items.evidence_quote: The ruler smiled. “If you are not back by sunset on the third day, this stranger will die.”
items.note: 結婚式のための猶予と、戻らなければ人質が死ぬ条件が示されています。

items.evidence_quote: He fought to reach the other side. At last, he caught a tree branch and pulled himself out.
items.note: 危険な川と襲撃者が帰路を妨げ、彼を消耗させます。

items.evidence_quote: He could rest here. He could stay alive.
items.note: 約束を捨てて帰らない誘惑に駆られています。

items.evidence_quote: “I will not let him laugh at me.”
items.note: 決意を取り戻す動機が友人への信頼ではなく、支配者に笑われたくない気持ちです。

items.evidence_quote: When he reached the city square, a guard was lifting his sword.
items.note: 処刑が始まる直前に到着しています。
